commands.name: focus-discuss
commands.description: Show or set discussion mode. Usage: /focus-discuss off | block | read

commands.description: Disable discuss mode (allow all tools). Shortcut for /focus-discuss off

commands.description: Block all tool calls (full discuss mode). Shortcut for /focus-discuss block

commands.description: Block git commit bash commands until collaborative review is complete

commands.name: focus-commit-guard-off
commands.description: Allow git commit bash commands again
